title: OpenSky Altitude Hold Anomaly
dataSources: ADS-B aircraft snapshots (`adsb:aircraft`), personal flight logbook (`flight:log`), commute trips (`commute:trip`), transit arrivals (`transit:arrival`), geofence events (`geofence:event`), travel documents (`travel:document`), fare quotes (`airprice:quote`).
app: Home ADS-B receiver (dump1090/readsb/tar1090 JSON feed), personal flight logbook exports, commute/transit APIs, and phone geofence webhooks via Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=opensky:state
streamstats window=10 stdev(baro_altitude_m) as alt_sd by icao24
where alt_sd<5 AND velocity_mps>100
description: Finds OpenSky tracks with unusually stable altitude at high speed.
value: Surfacing opensky altitude hold anomaly helps you act before small issues become habits.
implementation: Ingest the relevant travel, commute & flight-spotting export into `index=personal` and schedule this search weekly.
visualization: Table or chart of key fields.
grandmaExplanation: It frames when opensky altitude hold anomaly matters for your routine.
